name: oem-publisher-reseller-research
description: Research public evidence of product ownership, distribution channels, supplier authorization, and reseller relationships.

interface.longDescription: Investigate public evidence of manufacturers, publishers, distributors, resellers, authorization scope, affiliations, and purchasing channel restrictions.
defaultPrompt: Explain the documented relationship between this publisher and distributor.

Compare documented purchasing channels for this product.
